subject: SAML & SCIM evidence request — account bindings, role mappings, least-privilege attestation
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@greenfield-analytics.com>
To: nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
Cc: security.team@greenfield-analytics.com
Date: 2027-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Data request — SAML assertion samples & SCIM delta for account bindings

Hi Nikhil,

We’re kicking off the access-control portion of our SIG/CUSTOMER-SIG review for the POC account. To complete our assessment we need a short evidence bundle focused on SSO/SCIM/RBAC:

- A handful of SAML assertion samples (both successful login and an expired-token example). Please redact any long-lived session tokens, but include attribute names and values (NameID format, email, groups, roles).
- SCIM provisioning delta logs (create/update/delete) covering 2027-05-20 -> 2027-05-27 for the Greenfield tenant. CSV or JSON is fine.
- Role-to-group mapping export and a brief description of the group naming convention (we need to map groups to least-privilege roles).
- A signed least-privilege attestation for the admin/owner roles (template attached would be fine).

Timeline: can you get this to us by COB PDT on Friday 2027-06-04? If that’s aggressive, please propose a staggered delivery (SAML + SCIM first, attestation later).

Also: do you have a preferred mechanism for sharing assertion samples (DocShare link or Drive)? We need to ensure we can access without MFA roadblocks for our third-party reviewer.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alex Porter
Security Analyst, Greenfield Analytics
alex.porter@greenfield-analytics.com

(Attachment: evidence_request_outline.pdf)
From: nikhil.sharma@redwood.com <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@greenfield-analytics.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data request — SAML assertion samples & SCIM delta for account bindings

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can do this. Quick clarifying Qs so we scope correctly:

1) For the SAML assertions, do you need the full X509 cert chain (SHA1/SHA256 thumbprints) or just the assertion payloads with metadata? We can provide both but cert exports may need a short ops window.
2) For SCIM deltas, is the CSV schema you prefer the one in the template you sent? If not, we’ll use a simple: timestamp,event_type,user_id,external_id,changes summary.
3) For the attestation: do you require signatures from both product-security and platform (we typically sign from Head of Security + Platform Engineering manager)?

I’m looping in Lauren (Product Security) and Rishi (SRE) to line up exports and to confirm redaction rules. We’ll aim to get SAML samples and a SCIM delta snapshot by EOD next Tuesday (2027-06-01), and the attestation/doc sign-off by COB Friday (2027-06-04) unless you need an earlier staggered drop.

Sharing: Drive link + restricted view works for us; we’ll drop assertion samples into a shared folder with a short expiry link. If your reviewer needs a no-MFA access token, please confirm the reviewer email we should grant temporary access to.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: nikhil.sharma@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data request — SAML assertion samples & SCIM delta for account bindings

Thanks for the tag, Nikhil. Plan below — aiming for minimal back-and-forth: 

Deliverables (candidate scope):
- SAML assertion payloads: 3 examples (successful login with groups, successful login without groups, expired/tampered assertion). We will strip any ephemeral session IDs and redact long-lived cookies. Include NameID format, email, groups, roles, and the assertion issue/expiry timestamps. (File: saml_assertions_sample_20270527.txt)
- SCIM delta export: CSV covering 2027-05-20 -> 2027-05-27 with columns: ts,event_type,user_id,external_id,displayName,changes. (File: scim_delta_20270527.csv)
- Role mapping export: JSON export of role -> group bindings and a one-paragraph convention note. (File: role_mapping_export_20270527.json)
- Least-privilege attestation template: populate the template and have it signed by me + Marissa (Platform) — we will provide a PDF scan. (File to follow: least_privilege_attestation_signed.pdf)

Redaction policy: we will redact internal-only IDs (redact pattern: redwood-internal-*) and any SHA2 private key material. We will include cert thumbprints only.

Ops coordination: Rishi, can you pull the SCIM delta and the SAML assertion logs and drop them in the shared folder? If there are any PII rows we should mask, flag them and we’ll share a redacted copy.

I’ll coordinate final packaging and upload to Drive with a 14-day expiry link. If Greenfield’s reviewer requires a different retention window, let me know.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Security, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-01T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data request — SAML assertion samples & SCIM delta for account bindings

Forwarding the initial logs and a brief ops note.

On 2027-05-29 11:45, Lauren Bishop wrote:
> Thanks for the tag, Nikhil. Plan below — aiming for minimal back-and-forth:
> ...

Attached: scim_delta_20270527.csv (sample rows included), saml_assertions_sample_20270527.txt (assertion payloads). The SCIM dump includes create/update/delete events and a short user-change summary column. I removed any device_fingerprint and session_token fields per Lauren’s redaction rules.

A couple of operational notes:
- The SCIM source is the provisioning worker in prod-us-west-2 (tenant: greenfield-prod). Timestamps are UTC in the CSV.
- SAML logs were pulled from our assertion logging pipeline and include inbound IdP->SP saml responses; we kept issuer and NameID.

If you want me to reformat the SCIM CSV to include a separate column for "changed_attributes" instead of a summarized text blob, say the word and I’ll regenerate.

Files attached: scim_delta_20270527.csv, saml_assertions_sample_20270527.txt, role_mapping_export_20270527.json

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: nikhil.sharma@redwood.com <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@greenfield-analytics.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Data request — SAML assertion samples & SCIM delta for account bindings

Alex — attaching the package we discussed. Summary of what’s in the Drive folder and short notes: 

1) saml_assertions_sample_20270527.txt — three assertion payloads (successful+groups, successful+no-groups, expired). We have redacted internal session ids but left attribute names and values.
2) scim_delta_20270527.csv — provisioning events 2027-05-20 -> 2027-05-27 (UTC timestamps).
3) role_mapping_export_20270527.json — role -> group binding export and a one-paragraph naming convention note inside the file.
4) least_privilege_attestation_signed.pdf — signed by Lauren Bishop (Product Security) and Marissa Cole (Platform Engineering).

Drive link (14-day expiry): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3ScimEvidence
HubSpot ticket: HUBSPOT-7654321 (Greenfield > Security intake).

If the reviewer prefers a CSV with explicit changed_attributes column, Rishi can regenerate — we tried to keep the initial drop compact. Let me know if you need the cert chain thumbprints; we can export the SHA256 thumbprint and add it to the package.

Thanks — reaching out if anything else is required.

Best,

Nikhil Sharma
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
(Attachment: least_privilege_attestation_signed.pdf, saml_assertions_sample_20270527.txt, scim_delta_20270527.csv, role_mapping_export_20270527.json)
